propositions: CLI facade constructs command identity through overlapping frozensets and intercept tables, causing parser/help drift and incomplete canonical help for 21 intercept-only commands.
Runtime and build-time command grammar must derive from a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory to eliminate manual syntax authority and documentation drift.

Lazy route registry must record canonical identity, spellings, handler references, parser factories, and policies to enable pre-operation help/overview resolution without operation composition or mount side effects.

Help/overview generation resolves all parser factories at build time to commit authoritative package-help and overview bytes that runtime reads before configuration materialization or handler resolution.

Exact compatibility spellings (bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard), hidden commands (bridge-status), and retired commands (purge-bridge) must preserve historical behavior while deriving syntax from canonical factories.
Optional capability postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) must be registered separately and resolved after mode/backend selection to avoid eager optional imports.
